summary: Form 8-K filed by Blue Owl Technology Income Corp. reports two items: an unregistered sale of 319,230 Class I shares for ~$3.1M (closed April 23, 2026, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg S), and a declared monthly distribution of ~$0.074775 per share across three classes payable May 31, 2026. The filing also updates the status of an ongoing $5B public offering. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situations event present. Routine disclosure of equity sales and dividend declaration.
